UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile and synced app preferences for Future AI.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: User display name shown on profile and dashboard.

preferredLanguage.description: Preferred response language for Future AI.

glowBoostEnabled.description: Whether enhanced neon glow animations are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

ChatHistoryEntry.title: Chat History Entry
ChatHistoryEntry.description: Saved AI conversation exchange owned privately by a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

title.description: Short summary title derived from the user prompt.

prompt.description: The user prompt submitted to Future AI.

response.description: The AI response returned by Gemini.

toolType.description: Identifier of the Future AI tool that generated this entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated.

GeminiUsageEvent.title: Gemini Usage Event
GeminiUsageEvent.description: Per-user immutable audit event tracking each Gemini backend call.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who triggered the Gemini request.

toolType.description: Feature/tool that invoked the Gemini server backend.

modelName.description: Gemini model identifier used on the server backend.

promptChars.description: Character count of the user prompt.

responseChars.description: Character count of the Gemini response.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Gemini call completed.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile and synced preferences document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Private cloud chat history subcollection scoped to a single authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/usage/{eventId}.description: Private per-user Gemini API usage tracking subcollection.
